faq.q: How do I choose a district?
faq.a: Decide what the purchase is for: living all year round, holidays or renting out. For living, look at infrastructure and schools (Oba, Cikcilli); for renting out, closeness to the beach and the centre. An expert will compare 2–3 districts for your needs.

faq.q: Can I view a property by video?
faq.a: Yes. We run live video viewings: the apartment, the view from the windows, the complex and the way to the sea. You can ask any questions.

faq.q: What costs are there on top of the price?
faq.a: TAPU registration tax, fees, translation and notary, DASK insurance and utility connections. We give a full estimate before booking.

faq.q: How are the agency's services paid for?
faq.a: Property search, viewings (in person and by video) and consultations are free. For resale properties the agency fee is 2% of the price + VAT (KDV); for our partners' new builds the developer pays it. For long-term rentals it is one month's rent. The terms are fixed in a contract before the first viewing.

trustq.q: Why do prices differ between websites?
trustq.a: The same property is often sold by several agencies. Prices differ because of the floor, view, furniture, commission and outdated listings. We compare the same unit: floor, area, view and terms of the deal.

trustq.q: How to spot a bait listing?
trustq.a: A price that is too low, no ID or complex address, "already sold, but there's a similar one". We show the date the price was checked and confirm availability before booking.
Send us the link on WhatsApp or via the form below — we'll check whether it is the same unit and what is included in the price.

listFaq.lifeQ: Which district is best for living all year round?
listFaq.lifeA: Where schools, clinics and shops are open all year: {names}. In resort villages some cafés and shops close in winter.
listFaq.rentQ: Where is it best to buy to rent out?
listFaq.rentA: Demand is steady by the sea and closer to the centre: {names}. We'll calculate the yield of a specific property including complex fees and management.
listFaq.cheapA: The cheapest areas are on the outskirts: {names}. The most expensive are the centre and Tepe.
listFaq.inlandA: {names} are not by the sea: the beach is 1.5–5 km away. But you get panoramic views, cooler summers and more space. Living there without a car is inconvenient.
listFaq.airportA: The nearest airport is Gazipasa-Alanya (GZP): 5–25 km from the eastern districts, about 38 km from the centre. Antalya International Airport (AYT) is roughly 100–170 km away depending on the district. Distances are shown on each district page.

districts.listSeoTitle: Districts of Alanya for buying property
districts.listSeo1: Alanya stretches almost 70 km along the Mediterranean: from the resort of Avsallar in the west to the separate town of Gazipasa with its airport in the east. Closer to the centre you get city life and the highest prices; on the outskirts, new complexes, quiet and lower prices. Tepe and Cikcilli are in the hills: you need to drive to the sea, but you get the views and cooler summers.
districts.listSeo2: For living all year round people usually choose Oba, Cikcilli, Mahmutlar and Konakli: schools, clinics and shops are open all year there. For renting out — the centre and seaside districts with a good promenade.

faq.priceQ: How much does an apartment cost {where}?
faq.priceInCatalog: Our catalogue currently has {n, plural, one {# property} other {# properties}} in the district, from {from}.
faq.priceA: {inCatalog}The average price is about {pm} per m². The price depends on the distance to the sea, the view, the floor and the age of the complex. The table by layout is above on this page.
faq.rentA: Long-term rent for a 1+1 apartment starts from {rent} per month. Landlords usually ask for a deposit of one month's rent and a contract of 6–12 months; utilities are paid separately.
faq.vnzhQ: Can I get a residence permit if I buy {where}?
faq.vnzhA: The Turkish migration service periodically closes certain neighbourhoods to new residence permits, and the list changes. Before booking we check the status of the specific address on the date of the deal and tell you in advance.
faq.airportQ: How do I get to the airport?
faq.airportA: Gazipasa-Alanya airport (GZP) is about {gzp} km away, Antalya airport (AYT) about {ayt} km. We can arrange a transfer for viewings and after the purchase.
faq.rentabilityHigh: Yes: rental demand {where} is steady, especially for 1+1 and 2+1 apartments near the sea. We'll calculate the yield of a specific property and explain rental management.
faq.rentabilityMid: Yes, but mostly in season: demand is high in summer and lower in winter. For year-round renting people usually choose districts closer to the centre. We'll calculate the yield of a specific property.
faq.rentabilityLow: {name} is less suited to renting out than seaside districts and those closer to the centre: people buy here mainly to live. If income matters, we'll find an option in another district.
